qs.ours: Among the other ceremonies at a solemn league, Homer (Iliad, iii. 270) says, " They poured water on the hands of the kings," ¦ " Tu genitor, cape sacra manu, patriosque penates. Me, bello e tanto digresaum et caede recenti, Attrectare nefas, donee me flumine vivo Abluero." *JSnHd,* II. 717.
